messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++17 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
int n, m, ans;
long double d = 1.0, eps = 1e-10;
int main() {
    int x, y, n;
    scanf("%d %d %d", &x, &y, &n);
    int g = __gcd(x, y);
    x /= g;
    y /= g;
    long long xx = 0, yy = 1, ans_xx = 0, ans_yy = 1;
    for (yy = 1; yy <= n; yy++) {
        while (abs(d * x / y - d * xx / yy) > abs(d * x / y - d * (xx + 10000) / yy))
            xx += 10000;
        while (abs(d * x / y - d * xx / yy) + eps > abs(d * x / y - d * (xx + 1) / yy))
            xx++;
        if (abs(d * x / y - d * xx / yy) < abs(d * x / y - d * ans_xx / ans_yy))
            ans_xx = xx, ans_yy = yy;
    }
    printf("%lld/%lld\n", max(0LL, ans_xx - (y == 2 && ans_xx != x)), ans_yy);
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
